title: Implement sections 3.3-3.6: Plugin scope isolation, testing standards, and build optimization
body:
Implements sections 3.3-3.6 from ARCHITECTURE_EVALUATION.md to improve plugin isolation, testing coverage, and build optimization.

## Changes Made

### 3.3 Plugin Scope Isolation ✅
Created a comprehensive scoped plugin system to prevent conflicts between plugins:

- **New `PluginScope` interface** in `@object-ui/types` defining the contract for plugin isolation
- **`PluginScopeImpl` class** in `@object-ui/core` implementing:
  - Scoped component registration with namespacing (prevents plugin conflicts)
  - Isolated state management (each plugin has its own state with size limits)
  - Scoped event bus (events don't leak between plugins)
  - Global event support for cross-plugin communication when needed
  - Automatic resource cleanup on plugin unload
- **Updated `PluginSystem`** to support both scoped (default) and legacy plugin loading modes
- **9 comprehensive integration tests** covering component isolation, state isolation, event isolation, lifecycle management, and legacy compatibility

### 3.4 TypeScript Configuration Consolidation ✅
Verified and documented existing shared TypeScript configurations:

- `tsconfig.base.json` with strict shared settings
- `tsconfig.react.json` extending base with React/JSX settings
- `tsconfig.node.json` extending base for Node packages
- All 24 package tsconfig files properly extending shared configs

### 3.5 Build Optimization ✅
Verified existing Turbo configuration for parallel builds (3-5x faster):

- `turbo.json` properly configured with dependency-aware pipeline
- Caching enabled for build outputs (`dist/**`, `.next/**`, `build/**`, `storybook-static/**`)
- Package scripts using turbo for parallel execution
- Build system already optimized for performance

### 3.6 Testing Coverage ✅
Enhanced testing standards and requirements:

- **Coverage thresholds** added to `vitest.config.mts`:
  - 80% for lines, functions, and statements
  - 75% for branches
- **`TESTING_STANDARDS.md`** comprehensive documentation including:
  - Testing guidelines and best practices
  - Unit, integration, and E2E test patterns
  - Visual regression testing setup with Chromatic
  - CI/CD integration guidance
  - Performance testing examples
- **Integration test examples** demonstrating plugin scope isolation testing patterns

## Files Changed

- `packages/types/src/plugin-scope.ts` - New PluginScope interface and types
- `packages/types/src/index.ts` - Export plugin scope types
- `packages/core/src/registry/PluginScopeImpl.ts` - Plugin scope implementation
- `packages/core/src/registry/PluginSystem.ts` - Updated to support scoped plugins
- `packages/core/src/index.ts` - Export PluginScopeImpl
- `packages/core/src/registry/__tests__/plugin-scope-integration.test.ts` - Integration tests
- `vitest.config.mts` - Added coverage thresholds
- `TESTING_STANDARDS.md` - Testing standards documentation

## Testing

- ✅ TypeScript compilation passes for all packages
- ✅ All 9 plugin scope integration tests passing
- ✅ Build process completes successfully
- ✅ Code review passed with no issues

The implementation provides a solid foundation for plugin isolation while maintaining backward compatibility with existing plugins.
